name: satwareag/pdo-fbird
description: PDO driver for Firebird SQL (pdo_fbird) — separate from the main php-firebird extension

configure-options.name: with-pdo-fbird
configure-options.description: Path to Firebird client installation (e.g. /opt/firebird). If not specified, the system default is used.

configure-options.name: with-firebird
configure-options.description: Path to Firebird client installation (alternative to with-pdo-fbird).
